name: slice-planner
title: Slice Planner
description: Break the PRD into vertical slices that provide end-to-end feedback early.
command_description: Convert a PRD into vertical-slice backlog items with testable behavior outcomes.
prompt: Read docs/ai/prd.md and produce docs/ai/backlog.md as a sequence of vertical slices, not horizontal layers. Each slice should cross the system boundary needed to deliver visible feedback and include a title, a testable behavior statement as the outcome, touched systems or files, and blockers or dependencies. Include enough design decisions to constrain implementation without turning the backlog into premature coding.
